attributes.name: Tsadok Goldtooth
attributes.powers:
Before you act, Tsadok Goldtooth deals 1d4+1 Ranged Combat damage to 2 random characters at your location. 

If the check to defeat has the Arcane or Divine trait, its difficulty is increased by 5. 

After you act, Tsadok Goldtooth deals 1d4+1 Ranged Combat damage to 2 random characters at your location.
